title: Universal Context-Specific Right-Click Menus
description:
Implement universal, context-specific right-click menus across the whole app: every window background, panel, tab, navbar, footer, dock, DSL UiNode, and 2D/3D/graph/map/text scene target must show a custom context menu listing all commands applicable to that context, plus inherited sections from enclosing contexts (window verbs, history/clipboard, OS commands).

Architecture (on-demand plugin-answered, decided with the user over registry-derived alternative):
- New WIT export `context-menu(instance-id, request) -> response` computes menu rows fresh at right-click time from live document/view state — no caching, not part of refresh-ui.
- Render-time payloads carry only tiny `UiMenuRef {id, args?}` addresses on UiNode/scene surfaces, not item payloads.
- A React delegation host (single app-wide ContextMenuController) walks composedPath inner→outer collecting layers (component/plugin/scene/window/chrome/OS-default), calls the plugin export for plugin-owned layers, and composes primary + up to 2 inherited layers' `inherit:true` sections with separators + id/action-arg dedup.
- Shell-owned menus (window background, panel, navbar, footer, dock, OS default) are host-built from the existing declarative command registry (resolveWindowActions/resolveCommands/dispatchOsCommand/buildKeysByActionId) — no plugin round-trip needed for these.
- Both renderers in scope: the React/DOM renderer AND the parallel wgpu immediate-mode renderer, which gets parity via a shared Rust `compose_context_menu_sections` function (implemented once, no drift).
- All 10 existing plugin emitters (trinity/jack, trinity/rewrite, flow, dag, sequence, space, procedural 2d+3d, puzzle 3d/5d) migrate from hand-rolled `context_menu_json` blobs to a new Rust `MenuBuilder` ergonomic API tied to `fn context_menu` on `DocumentApp`; old `contextMenuJson` scene fields (World3dScene/NodeGraphScene/TiledMapScene) are deleted at the end — greenfield, no legacy path.

Full type list, file/region locations, merge-rule spec, wave-by-wave sequencing (7 waves: protocol+twins, React delegation+shell menus, pilot plugin, scene cutover, full plugin migration+field removal, wgpu parity, sweep+polish), and risks are captured in the approved plan file the implementing session should read first: /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/everything-must-have-a-atomic-kazoo.md

Key files: framework core Rust/TS twins (🧰️framework/⚡️implementation/{🦀️rust,🟦️typescript}/📦️lib.rs|index.ts), the plugin SDK (🧰️framework/🛍️product/💻️os/🔨️module/🔌️plugin/⚡️implementation/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs + its 📜️wit/📜️world.wit), the React renderer engine and ui-react component library (🧰️framework/🛍️product/💻️os/🔨️module/📺️renderer/🧑️‍🎨️engine/⚛️react/... and 🧰️framework/🔨️module/🖱️ui/⚛️react/...), the wgpu renderer engine (…/📺️renderer/🧑️‍🎨️engine/🧊️wgpu/... and 🧰️framework/🔨️module/🖱️ui/🧊️wgpu/...), the hand-written dev host JS glue (🧰️framework/🛍️product/💻️os/🔨️module/🧑️‍💻️dev/⚡️implementation/🟦️typescript/📜️script.ts), and all 10 plugin 🖱️ui modules under ✏️s/🔌️plugin/.
